title: Investigating Failures of Automatic Translation in the Case of Unambiguous Gender

bias_targets.methodology: Crafting unambiguous English source sentences containing gender-neutral occupation nouns and gender-explicit triggers (e.g., pronouns or kinship terms), translating them into 20 languages with grammatical gender, and using a morphological tagger to evaluate whether the translated occupation noun is inflected with the correct grammatical gender. The evaluation also measures how accuracy drops when the correct gender mismatches the statistical stereotype of the occupation.
